title: DICOM CT scans show capillaries feeding eggs in a J-type

tellings.quote: You have great independent researchers like Gonzalo Chavez who helped set up tridactyls.org pointing out that the DICOM files made public, if you look at these CAT scans around even the J texts, the reptilians, you can see capillaries nourishing the eggs inside one of their bodies.

plain: CT scans of small three-fingered bodies found in Peru are said to show tiny blood vessels feeding eggs inside one of the reptile-like bodies, the type researchers call J-type. Michels tells it from the work of an independent researcher named Gonzalo Chavez, who helped set up the website tridactyls.org, pointing to the scan files made public there in DICOM, the standard format for medical images. Michels raises it because, if true, it would mean these bodies were once living, egg-bearing creatures and not something put together.
